thread:
lauren: Quick heads-up — noticed odd behavior when an in-flight generator triggers an auth refresh. The client resumes the stream and the last emitted token is replayed, so consumers see duplicates. Repro in sample: request long generator, trigger token refresh server-side, compare token sequence.

sam: interesting. i saw something like that too but assumed it was server-side dedupe not working. can you paste the minimal loop you used?

lauren: sure, simplified: 
```go
ctx := context.Background()
iter := client.Generator(ctx, req)
for iter.Next() {
  tok := iter.Token()
  process(tok)
}
if err := iter.Err(); err != nil { log.Println("iter err:", err) }
```
If the SDK transparently retries after auth refresh it appears to re-emit the last token before continuing.

ben: hmm. that implies our resume logic doesn't coordinate token checkpointing. We either need server-side at-least-once semantics with idempotent tokens, or client-side replay suppression.

ashwin: from a DX perspective, surprises are bad. Options: (1) make the SDK surface a ResumeBehavior enum (Never|IdempotentOnly|Auto) so app teams opt-in; (2) add a TokenID() on Token so apps can dedupe easily; (3) document that auth refresh may replay last token and recommend ForEach helper that does dedupe.

lauren: prefer SDK handles this transparently. Adding TokenID helps but still leaks friction. ResumeBehavior opt-in could be good for advanced flows. For default, SDK should prefer no-duplicate delivery when possible.

ben: implementation-wise, we can have the iterator remember the last token's fingerprint (hash of bytes) and skip the immediate duplicate after a resume. Cheap and backwards-compatible. Add a config flag ResumeDeDup bool default true.

sam: tests: unit test that simulates auth retry causing a reconnect and asserts no duplicate token observed; integration test that forces mid-stream refresh and validates sequence. Also add a note in onboarding docs about auth/retry semantics for streams.

ashwin: also audit auth middleware across Dedicated/private adapters. If some adapters do a higher-level reconnect the client behavior must be consistent. Add to PR checklist.

dev-bot: Created issue #518: "go-sdk: generator resume after auth refresh can replay last token; propose resume dedupe" — https://github.com/redwood-inference/go-sdk/issues/518

lauren: thanks. i'll prototype the simple fingerprint dedupe in a draft PR and expose a ResumeBehavior option + TokenID API in a follow-up if needed.

ben: +1. prefer minimal safe default (dedupe true) and ergonomic TokenID for advanced users.

sam: nice. once PR lands, update samples: show ForEach(ctx, fn) using built-in dedupe so quickstarts don't hit this.

ashwin: i'll review and run adapter audits. dev-bot: set milestone v0.15.0.

dev-bot: Milestone set to v0.15.0; PR draft expected.
